movie.title: Anthony Joshua vs. Kristian Prenga
movie.overview: Anthony Joshua makes his highly anticipated return to the ring against knockout artist Kristian Prenga in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: In a thrilling heavyweight clash, former champion Anthony Joshua survives two dramatic first-round knockdowns before roaring back to knock out power-puncher Kristian Prenga in round two.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Anthony Joshua makes his high-stakes return to the boxing ring against fierce knockout artist Kristian Prenga in Saudi Arabia. The tension reaches an immediate high when Prenga shockingly floors Joshua twice in the opening round, putting Joshua's career and mega-fight prospects on the line. Showing incredible resilience, Joshua resets in the second round to unleash a brutal combination that lays out his opponent, securing a dramatic stoppage victory.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Former two-time heavyweight champion Anthony Joshua steps into the ring in Saudi Arabia for a high-profile comeback bout against dangerous knockout artist Kristian Prenga. With massive future fights hanging in the balance, Joshua aims to deliver a statement performance to show he is back at the top of his game. However, disaster strikes in the opening round when Prenga lands a series of heavy power punches, sending Joshua to the canvas twice and stunning the fight world. Shaken but determined, Joshua manages to survive the frantic first three minutes and return to his corner to gather himself. Coming out focused for the second round, Joshua re-establishes his range and lands a devastating right hand that completely turns the tide. The brutal onslaught leaves Prenga unable to beat the count, sealing a spectacular, dramatic knockout victory for Joshua. Ultimately, the high-octane spectacle showcases Joshua's deep resolve and power as he overcomes early adversity to claim a triumphant win.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Anthony Joshua vs. Kristian Prenga captures an explosive, high-stakes heavyweight boxing showcase set in Saudi Arabia. Following a prolonged period away from the ring, former world heavyweight champion Anthony Joshua faces formidable Albanian knockout artist Kristian Prenga in a crucial bout designed to test his championship mettle. Tensions peak early when Prenga's explosive punch power presents an immediate threat, pushing Joshua to his absolute limits in a wild opening round. With his future at the elite level hanging by a thread, Joshua relies on his championship experience, tactical adjustments, and raw punching power to stage a dramatic turnaround. The event delivers non-stop ring action, showcasing intense drama, resilience, and heavy-handed excitement for fight fans worldwide.
